execution.title: Voice task execution
execution.description: Tasks use a dedicated conversation and the existing local execution service. Writes, deletion and dangerous commands need approval for each call; unsupported tools and workspace escapes are denied.
execution.workspaceHint: Choose an existing absolute directory. A task never borrows the current chat workspace.
execution.modelHint: This selection is separate from the quick dialogue model and reuses saved provider credentials.
execution.presetHint: Optional. The host verifies that this preset supports the built-in runtime and resolves a usable model.
execution.catalogFailed: Could not load presets. You can retry or select an explicit model.
execution.ready: Execution configuration verified. A task is accepted only after a real receipt.
execution.unavailable: Execution is unavailable. Save a valid workspace and model or preset, then retry synchronization.
execution.failed: Could not verify or save execution settings. Check the workspace, model and preset, then retry.

task.confirmationDetailRequired: The complete operation scope needs review in the panel. Check all arguments before allowing it once; expiry still denies execution.
task.confirmationFailed: Voice confirmation did not complete. Check the actual tool status; a call cannot proceed without valid approval.
task.confirmationHint: Check the actual tool and arguments. Permission applies once; denial or expiry prevents execution.
task.none: There is no bound voice task. No execution was started by this control request.
task.audioUnavailable: The task result is available as text. Its audio notification could not be verified.
task.controlUnknown: Could not verify the task control result. Refresh the original task status; stopping voice does not cancel a task.
task.active: A voice task is already active. Check it before starting another.
task.scopeChanged: The voice session or task has changed. Please check the current task again.
task.persistenceFailed: The task could not be saved. Check available disk space before retrying.
task.title: Voice task
task.openFailed: Could not open the task. Please retry.
task.failedHint: Task status could not be verified or execution failed. Open the full task for details; do not submit it again until checked.

status.queued: Task queued; waiting for the active task to finish
status.delivering: Submitting task; acceptance is not yet verified
status.unknown: Acceptance not yet verified. Checking the original receipt.
status.accepted: Task accepted; waiting for the execution result
status.cancelling: Cancelling; waiting for the execution receipt

task.noActive: There is no voice task to query or cancel.

reason.preempted: Superseded by speech or a state change
reason.timeout: Output did not finish in time

feedback.title: Sound feedback
feedback.description: Hear when to speak, when speech was recognized, and when the conversation ends.
feedback.modeHint: Light includes a listening reminder and limited processing cues. Essential keeps transition cues.
feedback.volumeHint: Only changes cue volume. Zero mutes cues; system volume still applies.
feedback.speakRepliesHint: When off, replies and follow-up still work on screen, but answers and spoken explanations cannot be heard away from the screen.
feedback.previewHint: Preview uses the saved volume. Enable the voice service and wait until it is idle. No recording or model request is started.
feedback.failed: Could not read or save sound settings. Your unsaved changes are retained.
feedback.applied: Saved and applied to the current voice service.
feedback.pending: Saved preference has not been verified on the voice service. Enable the service or save again to retry.
feedback.previewBusy: The voice service is busy. Preview when the conversation ends.
feedback.previewMuted: Cues are off or volume is zero. Change and save the settings to preview.
feedback.previewFailed: Could not play the cue. Check the voice service and output device.

dialogue.title: Quick reply model
dialogue.description: Automatically selects an available quick reply model. Tasks use the bound conversation's workspace, model and preset.
dialogue.default: Automatically use a Flowy Cloud chat model
dialogue.unavailable: No dialogue model is available. Check provider configuration, enabled models and Flowy login.
dialogue.failed: Could not read the quick reply model. Reopen settings to retry.

audio.halfDuplex: Half duplex: local echo cancellation is not ready; automatic interruption during playback is disabled.
audio.bargeInTest: Interruption control test: echo-free test audio only.

audio.wakeOnly: ASR recognized only the wake phrase, with no question. Start again and say the full question.
audio.captureNoPcm: No microphone audio arrived within six seconds. Listening ended; check your input device and retry.
audio.captureClosed: Microphone capture stopped. Text is preserved. Check the device connection; the service will retry when idle unless you stopped voice manually.
audio.speechNotDetected: Audio arrived, but speech was not detected within six seconds, so ASR did not start. Move closer to the microphone and try again.
audio.vadMissing: The speech detection model is missing. Verify and repair the model suite.
audio.vadFailed: The speech detection model could not load. Verify and repair the model suite.
audio.modelNetwork: The dialogue model connection failed or timed out. Check the model service.
audio.modelAuth: Dialogue model authorization failed. Check its login or API key configuration.
audio.modelRejected: The dialogue model rejected the request. Check the service and model configuration.
audio.modelInvalid: The model response does not match the voice format. Its complete output is preserved below.
audio.ttsFailed: Speech synthesis failed or timed out. The reply is preserved as text; you can continue speaking.
audio.ttsRateLimited: Speech service rate limited. The reply is preserved as text; you can continue speaking shortly.
audio.ttsEmpty: The speech service returned no audio. The text reply is preserved.
audio.speakerFailed: The speaker is unavailable or playback failed. The text reply is preserved.
audio.taskMissing: Voice tasks are not connected to the execution service. No task was submitted.
audio.waiting: Audio diagnostics have not arrived. If this persists, update the host and voice service.
audio.noPcm: No audio frames yet, or capture interrupted
audio.asrEmpty: Speech recognition ran but returned no text. Check the input level and try again.
audio.dialogueMissing: Speech was recognized, but the dialogue model is not connected yet.
audio.modelTimeout: The dialogue model response timed out. Received text is preserved. Please try again.
audio.bindingInvalid: This voice session binding is no longer valid. Wake again.
audio.bindingBusy: The target is busy or was cleared. Generated content is retained but was not added to its history.
audio.recordConflict: This voice record has conflicting identity or content. Wake again.
audio.recordFailed: The original speech could not be saved. The dialogue model was not called for this turn. Check local storage.
audio.generationUnknown: Generation already started for this voice record, but its outcome is unverified. It will not be retried automatically.
audio.projectionFailed: Generated text stays visible in this panel. Local saving is incomplete. Check storage space or permissions.

service.acousticUnavailableDesc: The process is connected, but the microphone, wake detection or recognition chain is not fully ready.
service.readyDesc: The local acoustic chain is ready to try wake. The switch saves enabled intent; it does not mean all dialogue capabilities are configured.
